class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):

import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessor

class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def process_object_preselection(self, df, dataset):
        """Create MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4"""
        muons = df["Muon"]
        mask = (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        df["MuonGood"] = muons[mask]
        return df
    
    def process_object_counting(self, df, dataset):
        """Store number of selected muons per event"""
        df["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(df["MuonGood"])
        return df
